body.statement: For every \(C\in\mathfrak S_p\), \(\operatorname{Enum}(C)=\mathcal R(C)=\{D\in\mathfrak S_p:\mathsf S(D)=\mathsf S(C)\}\). Static equality can be decided using \(O(p^3)\) elementary comparisons with adjacency matrices and canonical block bitsets. The enumeration is duplicate-free by exact state memoization, terminates after at most \(p!\) emitted states, and a breadth-first predecessor tree returns for every emitted \(D\) a shortest path of length \(\delta(C,D)\).
body.justification: The population equivalence theorem becomes operational only after it yields a terminating complete enumerator and shortest certificates.
body.gap: WienobstLuttermannBannachLiskiewicz2023 gives linear-delay enumeration for ordinary Markov classes with fixed background knowledge, but does not handle state-dependent partition transport; the present guaranteed algorithm is finite and output-bounded rather than linear-delay.
body.consumer: Component enumeration supplies every graph-specific adjustment and path functional needed for possible-effect analysis under blocked coefficient information.
